product_family: CoCounsel - generative AI legal assistant suite including CoCounsel Legal, CoCounsel Drafting, and Microsoft 365 integrations for legal professionals. Originally developed by Casetext (acquired July 2023), now Thomson Reuters' flagship professional AI product.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: CoCounsel maintains SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 compliance built into our development process

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: CoCounsel maintains SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 compliance built into our development process

certifications.name: ISO 42001 (AI Management Systems)
certifications.proof_quote: CoCounsel has been successfully included in Thomson Reuters' AI Management System ISO/IEC 42001:2023 Certification, among the earliest generative AI systems in professional services to attain this standard

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Thomson Reuters maintains commitment to honoring privacy and keeping personal data safe consistent with GDPR. CoCounsel includes data residency controls to ensure information stays within required geographic boundaries with region-based hosting available in the UK, Australia, and Canada.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: Thomson Reuters achieved FedRAMP 'In Process' status for Westlaw and Practical Law products; CoCounsel is still invested to secure FedRAMP authorization

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of HIPAA certification found on vendor's own domain. Thomson Reuters provides HIPAA guidance materials for law firms but does not claim HIPAA BAA coverage for CoCounsel itself.

privacy.ai_training_note: CoCounsel explicitly does not use user content or prompts to train CoCounsel, underlying language models, or third-party AI models (OpenAI GPT, Google Gemini). Third-party partners are contractually prohibited from using customer data for model training. Thomson Reuters processes all GenAI requests under Thomson Reuters identity, never disclosing individual customer identity to LLM providers.
privacy.data_region: Primary: United States (with separate availability zones for backup). Optional region-based hosting: UK, Australia, Canada. All interactions with OpenAI GPT and Google Gemini processed in U.S.

security.name: Zero-retention API architecture
security.value: All GenAI LLM requests use zero-retention API calls; data not stored by third parties

security.name: Threat detection
security.value: 24/7 dedicated security monitoring and threat detection

security.name: Data retention policies
security.value: Customizable per customer; can be configured through account manager; users can delete content anytime

security.name: Access controls
security.value: Production environment restricted to authorized personnel; limit-collection principle applied

products.name: CoCounsel Legal
products.data_scope: Legal documents, research, case analysis, drafting; sensitive professional data
products.notes: Flagship product; retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds outputs in Westlaw and Practical Law content with citations; used by 10,000+ law firms

products.name: CoCounsel Drafting
products.notes: Specialized drafting module; data not used for model training

products.name: CoCounsel for Outlook
products.notes: Microsoft 365 App Certified; includes security testing and compliance verification

compare.pricing_model: Subscription-based (details vary by product and tier); contact sales for pricing
compare.data_residency: US default; optional UK, Australia, Canada hosting available
